query.sql: select extract(event_message,'AI_PHASE_MS[^A-Z]*([A-Z_]+)') as phase, extract(event_message,'(SUCCEEDED|FAILED)') as outcome, count() as n, min(toFloat64OrNull(extract(event_message,'AI_PHASE_MS[^A-Z]*[A-Z_]+[^0-9]*([0-9]+)'))) as min_ms, quantileExact(0.5)(toFloat64OrNull(extract(event_message,'AI_PHASE_MS[^A-Z]*[A-Z_]+[^0-9]*([0-9]+)'))) as p50_ms, quantileExact(0.95)(toFloat64OrNull(extract(event_message,'AI_PHASE_MS[^A-Z]*[A-Z_]+[^0-9]*([0-9]+)'))) as p95_ms, max(toFloat64OrNull(extract(event_message,'AI_PHASE_MS[^A-Z]*[A-Z_]+[^0-9]*([0-9]+)'))) as max_ms from logs where source='function_logs' and position(event_message,'AI_PHASE_MS')>0 group by phase,outcome order by phase,outcome

pricing.query: select jsonb_build_object('checked_at',clock_timestamp(),'budget',(select jsonb_build_object('enabled',enabled,'reservation_cap_enforced',reservation_cap_enforced,'ceiling_microusd',ceiling_microusd,'reserved_microusd',reserved_microusd,'price_valid_until',price_valid_until) from private.ai_test_budget_v5 where singleton),'price_functions',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'body_md5',md5(p.prosrc),'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='private' and p.proname in('ai_test_price_microusd','ai_test_stt_price_microusd')),'retained_usage_models',(select jsonb_agg(x) from(select model,count(*) as n,min(recorded_at) as first,max(recorded_at) as last from private.ai_test_usage_v5 group by model)x)) result

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ai_test_price_microusd(p_prompt_tokens integer, p_output_tokens integer)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select ceil(coalesce(p_prompt_tokens,0) * 0.75 + coalesce(p_output_tokens,0) * 3.75)::bigint;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ai_test_stt_price_microusd(p_audio_bytes bigint, p_transcript_chars integer)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select ceil(
    -- input: seconds x 25 tokens x 3.50 microUSD per token
    (greatest(p_audio_bytes, 0)::numeric / 32000.0) * 25 * 3.50
    -- output: conservative token bound x 21.00 microUSD per token
    + greatest(ceil((greatest(p_audio_bytes, 0)::numeric / 32000.0) / 60.0 * 175), ceil(greatest(p_transcript_chars, 0)::numeric / 2.0)) * 21.00
  )::bigint;
$function$
